title: 第14章宁荣荣的厚脸皮，小舞要逃离史莱克-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    奥斯卡双眼直冒精芒，激动地站起身来，向他讨要。

    他是食物系魂师，修炼速度本来就很慢，跟其他战斗系魂师相比，差不多相差一倍。

    要知道，他的资质极高，是先天满魂力十级的超级天赋。

    可就算是如此，他的修行速度还是很慢。

    若是他每隔三天就能吃一颗增魂丹，就能让他的修行速度达到同等天赋的战斗系魂师。

    以他先天满魂力十级的超级天赋，肯定有希望成为斗罗大陆历史上第一位食物系封号斗罗。

    增魂丹对他太重要了。

    唐三、小舞等人听闻，心神一震。

    难道刚才那颗小小的丹药真能提升一倍的修行速度？

    如果真是如此，那增魂丹的效果就太强了。

    “有，但最多再给你两颗。”

    “若是你还想要更多，那就要看你的态度。”

    叶寒注意到了大家的表情变化，又拿出了两颗增魂丹，随手扔了过去。

    “多谢老大！”

    “老大，你真帅！”

    奥斯卡小心翼翼地捧在手心，将其揣好，等药效过了以后，他再吃第二颗。

    【叮！奥斯卡忠诚度15%，奖励10000兑换值。】

    “老大，我也想要，你能给我吗？”

    “其实，我也很听话的。”

    “刚才都是我不对，我自罚。”

    “老大，求你了，也给我几颗吧。”

    马红俊太了解奥斯卡的性格了。

    如果丹药是假的，没有提升一倍修行速度的效果，他才不会这么高兴。

    看来叶寒给的丹药，的确有用啊。

    为了能够得到增魂丹，他扇了自己一巴掌，以表诚意。

    “好，给你三颗。”

    “以后想要更多，还要看你的表现。”

    叶寒见效果来了，拿出最后三颗低级增魂丹递了过去。

    “谢谢老大！”

    马红俊见叶寒这么大方，真把丹药给他了，而且一给就是三颗，高兴地向他表示感激。

    随后，他将一颗增魂丹吃下，盘身修炼起来。

    果然，修行速度提升了一倍，像是开了挂。

    【叮！恭喜宿主激活马红俊家族贡献模式，忠诚度：10%，贡献值：0，奖励10000兑换值。】

    “老大，你太厉害了。”

    “这种丹药你都能研究出来。”

    “若是把增魂丹拿出去卖，一颗至少价值千金。”

    马红俊感知到效果后，激动地站了起来，想办法讨好他，获得更多的增魂丹。

    三颗增魂丹太少了，只能让他修炼九天。

    若是他能有一百颗，甚至一千颗，一万颗就好了。

    只要有足够的增魂丹，他还怕无法成为封号斗罗？

    “胖子，瞧你说的，老大是谁。”

    “那可是天才。”

    “这种东西对老大来讲，就是洒洒水。”

    “老大，以后你就是我的明灯，你让我往东，我绝对不往西。”

    “我对你的敬仰，有如滔滔江水连绵不绝，又有如黄河泛滥一发不可收拾！”

    奥斯卡也站了起来，在看向叶寒的眼神中满是崇拜之色。

    为了能够成为斗罗大陆有史以来第一位食物系封号斗罗，他打算今后皆以叶寒为尊。

    如此慷慨而又有本事的老大，从哪儿找啊。

    像这种逆天的宝贝，可不是随便就能拿出手送人的。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Oscar’s eyes were shining brightly, he stood up excitedly and asked for it from him.

He is a food-type soul master, and his cultivation speed is very slow. Compared with other combat-type soul masters, his cultivation speed is almost twice as fast.

You must know that his qualifications are extremely high, and he is a super talent with an innate soul power of level ten.

But even so, his cultivation speed is still very slow.

If he can take a soul-enhancing pill every three days, his training speed will be as fast as that of a combat-type soul master with the same talent.

With his innate super talent of tenth level soul power, he definitely has the hope of becoming the first food-type titled Douluo in the history of Douluo Continent.

The soul-enhancing pill is too important to him.

Tang San, Xiao Wu and others were shocked when they heard this.

Could it be that the little pill just now can really double the speed of practice?

If this is really the case, then the effect of the soul-enhancing pill is too strong.

"Yes, but I will give you two more at most."

"If you want more, it depends on your attitude."

Ye Han noticed the change in everyone's expressions, took out two more soul-enhancing pills, and threw them casually.

"Thank you, boss!"

"Boss, you are so handsome!"

Oscar carefully held it in the palm of his hand and tucked it away. After the effect of the medicine wore off, he took the second pill.

【Ding!Oscar’s loyalty is 15%, and the reward is 10,000 redemption points.】

“Boss, I want it too, can you give it to me?”

"Actually, I am also very obedient."

"It was all my fault just now, I punish myself."

“Boss, please, give me a few too.”

Ma Hongjun understands Oscar’s character very well.

If the elixir were fake and had no effect of doubling the speed of cultivation, he would not be so happy.

It seems that the pill Ye Han gave is indeed useful.

In order to get the soul-enhancing pill, he slapped himself to show his sincerity.

"Okay, I'll give you three."

"If you want more in the future, it depends on your performance."

Seeing that the effect was coming, Ye Han took out the last three low-level soul-enhancing pills and handed them over.

"Thank you, boss!"

Seeing that Ye Han was so generous, Ma Hongjun actually gave him the pills, three at a time, and happily expressed his gratitude to him.

Afterwards, he ate a soul-enhancing pill and started practicing.

Sure enough, the cultivation speed doubled, as if it was a cheat.

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for activating the Ma Hongjun family contribution mode. Loyalty: 10%, contribution value: 0, and reward 10,000 exchange value.】

"Boss, you are so awesome."

"You can research this kind of elixir."

"If you sell the soul-enhancing pills, one would be worth at least a thousand gold."

After Ma Hongjun sensed the effect, he stood up excitedly and tried to find a way to please him and get more soul-enhancing pills.

Three soul-enhancing pills are too few, so he can only practice for nine days.

It would be great if he could have a hundred, or even a thousand, or ten thousand.

As long as he has enough soul-enhancing pills, is he afraid that he will not be able to become a titled Douluo?

"Fat man, let's see who the boss is."

"That's genius."

"For the boss, this kind of thing is just a piece of cake."

"Boss, you will be my beacon from now on. If you ask me to go east, I will never go west."

"My admiration for you is like the endless flow of a surging river, and like the overflowing Yellow River that is out of control!"

Oscar also stood up, looking at Ye Han with admiration in his eyes.

In order to become the first food-type titled Douluo in the history of Douluo Continent, he plans to respect Ye Han from now on.

Where can I find such a generous and capable boss?

A treasure like this that defies heaven cannot be given away casually.
Page (1/3)
